# Dino Discovery

> AI-powered dinosaur generator for kids. Children pick five attributes (size, habitat, diet, feature, personality) through a short wizard, and get back an AI-generated dinosaur — a name, a short description, and an illustrated image — reframed as an alternate-reality-game species discovery: a deterministic species ID, a rarity tier, illustrated habitat art, and a 3D flip/tilt collectible card that can be downloaded and shared.

- Live app: https://dino-discovery-generator.pages.dev
- Free to use, no account required.
- Each combination of the five attributes deterministically maps to the same species ID and rarity tier, so the same choices always "rediscover" the same species.
- Generated cards can be downloaded as a PNG and shared via a unique link.

## Key facts

- Built with Vite, React, and TypeScript, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
- Dinosaur images and descriptions are generated with AI (Anthropic Claude for text, OpenAI for images) and cached, so repeated attribute combinations reuse the same generated species instead of creating a new one each time.
- Intended audience: children aged roughly 5–10, in Spanish.
